lines.zh: 我挪一步，底座刮着石砖。
lines.en: One step and my base scrapes the bricks.

lines.zh: 工程师没给我装腿，我拖过去。
lines.en: No legs were fitted; I drag myself along.
My iron arms sway and the quiver rattles.

lines.zh: 我走三步，就得重新校准。
lines.en: Three steps, then I must recalibrate.
My wheel caught in a brick gap.
I grind across the floor and turn slowly.
Every step sounds like a nail being driven.

lines.zh: 我绕到墙角，那里视野好。
lines.en: I roll to the corner for a better angle.
My base is heavy; walking is hard work.
I shove a crate out of my path.

lines.zh: 铁脚踩过地板，留下划痕。
lines.en: Iron feet leave scratches on the floor.
I am loud; I cannot hide.
Two more blocks and I have the range.
Someone is moving things behind me.
I shift along the wall to the doorway.

lines.zh: 轮子压过台阶，颠了一下。
lines.en: My wheels hit the step and jolt.

lines.zh: 我数着弹药，还剩四十三支。
lines.en: Counting ammo: forty-three arrows left.

lines.zh: 炮管凉下来，我松了扳机。
lines.en: The barrels cool; I release the trigger.
No visitors, so I swab the barrels.
I listen to the corridor's echo.
My gears idle with a soft whir.

lines.zh: 灰尘落进炮口，我吹了吹。
lines.en: Dust in the muzzles; I blow it out.
I stared at this wall all night.

lines.zh: 过热之后，我又能连射了。
lines.en: Cooled down; ready to fire again.
My sight is slightly off.
The engineer said not to fire at random.
I straighten the last arrow.
Something scuttles under the floor.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得开炮的目标。
lines.en: I wait for a target worth the ammo.
Standing long stiffens my joints.
I am reading the wind; it bends arrows.

lines.zh: 扳机松着，可我一直盯着。
lines.en: The trigger is slack, but I keep watching.
You are standing in my firing arc.

lines.zh: 我转过来，是在看你，不是欢迎。
lines.en: I turn to look, not to welcome.
Your height makes an easy target.
Do not wave; I read it as a signal.

lines.zh: 我的两只炮口都对着你。
lines.en: Both my barrels point at you.

lines.zh: 你身上有工程师的味道。
lines.en: You carry the engineer's scent.

lines.zh: 炮口转过来，我在算你的距离。
lines.en: My barrels turn; I'm calculating your range.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就抬一度。
lines.en: One step closer and I raise one degree.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好压在准星上。
lines.en: Your shadow sits right on my sight.
I am logging your position.
Looking up at the barrels is the right instinct.
You have three seconds to state your business.
My barrel got bent.
My gears have jammed solid.
My quiver split open.
That hit ruined my sight.
Smoking, but still aiming.
My base tilted; I cannot stand steady.
Stop hammering my shell.
All my ammo spilled everywhere.
I can still fight, just slower.

lines.zh: 这一下让我提前过热了。
lines.en: That hit pushed me into overheating.

lines.zh: 你腰上那筒箭，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see that quiver on your belt.
Give me arrows and I skip a volley.
That bag of iron bits would make good shrapnel.
I want that oil can in your hand.
My barrels are thirsty; hear them?
One arrow for one safe path?

lines.zh: 我闻到你包里的火药味。
lines.en: I smell powder in your pack.
Ammo on the ground; back away ten paces.
I envy that crossbow on your shoulder.
My gears need oil to turn smoothly.

lines.zh: 那箱箭，是从兵工厂搬的？
lines.en: Those arrows come from the arsenal?

lines.zh: 给我填满，我就不数你了。
lines.en: Fill me up and I stop counting you.

lines.zh: 你手上那支箭，箭头真亮。
lines.en: The arrowhead in your hand is so bright.
Do not rush off; I have not looked my fill.
That bundle of arrows; do not hide it.

lines.zh: 给我一块铁，我给你腾路。
lines.en: One iron ingot and I clear the way.
You knocked my sight off.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，炮口会碰头。
lines.en: Not so close; our muzzles will bump.
You shifted my base.
Iron on iron makes a terrible noise.
You stepped on my ammo crate.
Back up; I need room to turn.
That bump jammed my gears.
You knocked an arrow loose.
I steadied myself; do not do that again.
Bumping me is like pulling my trigger.

lines.zh: 两座炮塔交叉，才没有死角。
lines.en: Two turrets cross-fire and leave no blind spot.
You take the east hall; I watch the west.

lines.zh: 我的过热，正好由你补上。
lines.en: When I overheat, you cover.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背，谁也绕不过来。
lines.en: Back to back, no one flanks us.
Your rate of fire beats mine.

lines.zh: 一起开火，走廊就干净了。
lines.en: Firing together clears the corridor.

lines.zh: 你响一声，我就知道位置。
lines.en: One shot from you tells me where you are.
Whoever stalls, the other holds.
We share one ammo crate.

lines.zh: 工程师走了，只剩我们俩。
lines.en: The engineer is gone; only we remain.
One arrow; I pick it up.
This iron pipe can patch a barrel.
Oil on the floor; perfect for my gears.
I slot the arrow into my magazine.
A bolt fell off; I keep it.
This cloth will clean my muzzles.
Whose gear is this? Mine now.

lines.zh: 捡箭的时候，我还在瞄准。
lines.en: Even picking up arrows, I keep aiming.
There is no such thing as too much ammo.
I count them in one by one.
Someone entered the hall; I raise my barrels.
Target at thirty blocks.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，被我锁定了。
lines.en: Your footsteps are locked in.
Identification complete: you are hostile.
I settle my sight on your chest.

lines.zh: 两只炮口分开，封住两条路。
lines.en: Barrels split to cover both paths.
The one with the shield: legs first.

lines.zh: 你从转角探出头，太迟了。
lines.en: You peeked around the corner too late.
I hear a bowstring draw.
You are the only target.
I am waiting for your next move.
You go left; my barrels follow.
The arrow is already loaded.
Six blocks out, no wind to calculate.
Your shield will not last two volleys.
I hold the trigger halfway.
Do not count my arrows; you will lose track.

lines.zh: 我在等你踏入那块地砖。
lines.en: I wait for you to step on that tile.
My muzzles are warming up.
Three, two, one, fire.
I swing a barrel at your shoulder.
A bash still counts as firing.
My iron arm sweeps; step back.
Muzzle against you; do not move.
No arrow in that one, only iron.

lines.zh: 你贴太近了，我改用砸的。
lines.en: Too close; I switch to bashing.
One base turn sweeps you aside.
That bash heated my barrel.
Listen, that is iron ringing.
Do not grab my muzzle.

lines.zh: 工程师拧紧最后一颗螺栓，我醒了。
lines.en: The engineer tightened the last bolt; I woke.

lines.zh: 我从工作台上被推下来。
lines.en: I was pushed off the workbench.
Empty barrels; first I load.

lines.zh: 墙上的支架断了，我落地。
lines.en: The wall bracket broke and I hit the floor.
Open sightlines here; good.
My number is stamped on the base.
Someone pulled the starter lever.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是一扇门。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a door.
The gears begin to turn.
Task: hold this corridor.
Fire warps my barrels.
My base cracked in the fall.
Water in my gears makes them grind.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的支架掀翻。
lines.en: The shockwave flips my mount.
An arrow sticks in my seam.
Magic spins my gears backward.
No arrows left; my barrels click empty.
Lightning blackened my muzzle.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有落点，我算不了弹道。
lines.en: In the void there is no ground to range.
